modules.module_title: Develop and lead team of first responders

pcs.pc_description: specify the team members required to respond for aquatic rescue operation
ensure all the crew members have required and updated certifications as life savers
ensure that the crew members' physical fitness program is adequate and effective
identify training needs of the crew members based on their strengths and areas of improvement
encourage equality and non-discrimination in terms of gender, abilities, religion and background
conduct mock-drills of rescue operation in a simulated environment

modules.module_title: Prepare, maintain and test rescue equipment

pcs.pc_description: maintain adequate number of equipment for immediate rescue response
conduct regular safety checks of the equipment and machines
isolate any unsafe equipment, machinery and report to maintenance team
record the maintenance schedule of equipment and machinery as per the safety standards
ensure navigation equipment are in working condition (inland flood boats)
ensure adequate medical equipment like artificial resuscitation, oxygen mask, stretcher, etc. are readily available
ensure public address equipment such as loud speakers, mics, whistle are within reach
ensure communication devices such as radio, GPS units, mobile phones, are adequate for the team

pcs.pc_description: assess the search and rescue area, gather information on the scale of operation required
develop search and rescue strategy and techniques based on information available
identify rescue team members in accordance with strategy and nature of emergency
deploy navigation and rescue equipment as per the condition and the environment of the rescue area
ensure team members are briefed on the strategy and their specific role in the rescue operation
allocate tasks to team members as per their level of competence and experience
establish communication system with each unit of rescue team
monitor performance of team members and strategy, as the scenario unfolds, to determine further requirements, if any
identify deployment of secondary rescue plan in conjunction with the primary plan (aerial rescue support, temporary mobility constructions, etc.)
apprise external agencies, government authorities and prepare for stand-by reinforcement
prepare evacuation plans based on weather forecast and risk assessment
establish mobile/temporary medical facility for rescued individuals till further help arrives

pcs.pc_description: ensure the first unit to enter aquatic environment uses personal protective gears and tethered to a point
undertake hazard identification drill such as sink holes, drains, deep gutters, etc. and mark them as unsafe zones
inspect and identify any floating or submerged hazards in the water like sharp objects, logs, etc.
identify submerged powerlines or current leaks and initiate immediate disconnection from its source
identify water contamination and exposure to any toxic chemicals
apply sandbagging, water diversion techniques to facilitate on foot navigation
create nearby ramps or launching points
conduct flood-boat pre-launch checks in accordance with the operational standards
ensure adequate rescue equipment like life jackets, throw-bags, inflatable tubes, poles, rope, etc. are loaded on the boat
ensure other essential equipment like public address equipment, binocular, torch, etc. are within reach
guide helmsman to follow planned route or course
use GPS equipment to monitor the positions of deployed flood-boats
coordinate with deployed flood-boats and call for withdraw/ change of course in case of no sightings of victims
report and prepare medical team for en- route and arrival of survivors or casualties, if any
ensure there are no signs of any harassment during the rescue operations
ensure entrapped casualties are extracted as per organizational policy
ensure all members of the rescue team are navigated back to the base location
follow the process of requesting for aerial evacuation/ rescue support as per the legislation and regulations
establish communication systems with the ground and air team members
ensure communication systems are selected to provide optimum capability
ensure hazards such as topography, tall infrastructure, etc. are assessed and communicated to the aerial rescue team
brief aerial rescue team on target location, drop zones, etc
create a report of the operation and share with the appropriate authority
ensure all rescue equipment are recovered, cleaned and serviced as per the standards and manufacturer's guidelines
report equipment failure and/or deficiency, if any
recognize signs and symptoms of operational stress in self and others and take recovery measures
interact with everyone in a gender, disability, and culturally sensitive manner
ensure women, particularly, feel comfortable, and safe
ensure confidentiality of all survivors as well as of casualties is maintained
apply conflict management techniques to maintain positive interaction
identify and report inappropriate behavior (e.g. sexual harassment) to appropriate authority
address self and others conscious or unconscious gender bias

pcs.pc_description: ensure personal hygiene
ensure equipment, gym area, restrooms etc. are sanitized before and after the usage

report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
advise clients of the facility's emergency procedures
ensure clients adhere to safety guidelines
provide first aid for minor injuries and refer severe injuries to qualified medical practitioner
perform Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) when required
